title: Concept: Video poster attribute holding a script URL
description: A video element whose poster is a javascript URL in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The poster is fetched when the player paints, and a script URL in that position is evaluated by engines that resolve the attribute as a URL without a scheme check.
applicability: Deployments that render a video element whose poster is a javascript URL into a customer- or partner-facing response.
